hero.name: Abdelhadev, Abdelhadi Bouchadi, full-stack developer in Agadir
hero.intro: I build web applications that people rely on every day: management systems, AI-powered apps and client platforms, from the data model to the last screen. Careful work, explained simply, delivered in stages you can see.

manifesto.label: How I work
manifesto.statement: People trust software with their schedules, their data and their daily operations. I build applications that deserve that trust: secure by design, and simple enough that nobody needs a manual.

dusk.label: After hours
dusk.title: When the office closes, the software keeps working.
dusk.sub: Agendas, records and invoices stay in order overnight, on infrastructure that belongs to you.

featured.title: Software for dental clinics
featured.body: DentaFlow runs the day of a clinic, from the first appointment to the last invoice. I adapt it to each clinic before it goes live.
featured.adapt: Your clinic's name, your data, your own server.

storage.cookies: This site sets no advertising or analytics cookies.
storage.session: It also keeps one piece of information in your browser's session storage: that you have already seen the opening animation, so the next pages open faster. It is gone when you close the tab.
